purpose: Own the accepted current RFC source/lifecycle projection, restart-persistent terminal-cascade proposals, and operation-scoped RFC archive history while leaving workbook staging, WFM/Task lifecycle, and Communication consequences to their owning packets.

tables.name: rfc_current_source_projection
columns: rfc_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
external_created_at_utc INTEGER CHECK(external_created_at_utc IS NULL OR external_created_at_utc>=0)
status_class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK(status_class IN ('unknown','pre_implement','implement_eligible','terminal_closed','terminal_cancelled'))
status_authority TEXT CHECK(status_authority IS NULL OR status_authority IN ('enhanced_rfc','wfm_provisional'))
last_update_utc INTEGER CHECK(last_update_utc IS NULL OR last_update_utc>=0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)

CHECK((status_text IS NULL AND status_evidence_id IS NULL AND status_authority IS NULL AND status_class='unknown' AND terminal_epoch_id IS NULL) OR (status_text IS NOT NULL AND status_evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND status_authority IS NOT NULL))
CHECK((status_class IN ('terminal_closed','terminal_cancelled') AND terminal_epoch_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status_class NOT IN ('terminal_closed','terminal_cancelled') AND terminal_epoch_id IS NULL))
rules: current source fields are accepted projection only; immutable observation/staging/provenance rows belong to LLD-04/HLD-05
each non-null evidence ID is an opaque immutable source-evidence identity validated through RfcSourceEvidenceProvider in the same acceptance UnitOfWork
field updates are independently non-destructive: missing/unknown/unusable evidence does not clear prior accepted values unless the field contract explicitly permits clearing
status_text is exact accepted normalized source vocabulary text; status_class is derived from the versioned RFC vocabulary and is never independently edited
WFM provisional status may populate only under LLD-04 precedence rules and cannot override accepted Enhanced RFC status

terminal_epoch_id is allocated only when accepted current status crosses from nonterminal/unknown into terminal; terminal-to-terminal correction preserves the epoch; accepted terminal reversal clears the current epoch without erasing prior proposal/history rows
projection is rebuildable from accepted source evidence and creates no independent source history

tables.name: rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals
columns: trigger_rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
terminal_status_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(terminal_status_class IN ('terminal_closed','terminal_cancelled'))
scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('exact_rfc','root_branch'))
proposal_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(proposal_state IN ('pending','executed','superseded'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
executed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
superseded_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK((proposal_state='pending' AND executed_at_utc IS NULL AND executed_command_id IS NULL AND superseded_at_utc IS NULL AND superseded_command_id IS NULL) OR (proposal_state='executed' AND executed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND executed_command_id IS NOT NULL AND superseded_at_utc IS NULL AND superseded_command_id IS NULL) OR (proposal_state='superseded' AND executed_at_utc IS NULL AND executed_command_id IS NULL AND superseded_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND superseded_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: one pending proposal exists at most per trigger RFC/terminal epoch
a subordinate terminal epoch captures exact_rfc scope; a root/master terminal epoch captures the exact current two-level branch
proposal creation is atomic with acceptance of the terminal status projection that created the terminal epoch
proposal membership is immutable evidence; stale scope does not rewrite it
material scope change before execution blocks execution and requires a new proposal that supersedes the stale pending proposal while retaining the same terminal epoch
participant failure rolls back execution and leaves the proposal pending

tables.name: rfc_terminal_cascade_rfc_members
columns: rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals(rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
captured_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(captured_role IN ('root','subordinate','standalone'))
rules: rows are immutable exact proposal evidence
root-branch membership contains the root and every direct subordinate exactly once
exact-rfc membership contains only the triggering RFC

tables.name: rfc_terminal_cascade_wfm_members
columns: rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals(rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
owning_rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: task_id is immutable cross-domain Task identity supplied and revalidated by LLD-05; this snapshot table is evidence and does not own Task lifecycle
only applicable active nonterminal WFM members returned by the Task cascade participant are captured
Local Tasks are never captured merely because they reference the RFC

tables.name: rfc_archive_operations
columns: requested_rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('exact_rfc','reviewed_branch'))
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: one committed operation records one exact reviewed archive action
pre-existing archived members are excluded from operation membership because the operation did not archive them
operation identity is immutable and is the authority for later operation-scoped restore

tables.name: rfc_archive_operation_members
columns: rfc_archive_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfc_archive_operations(rfc_archive_operation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: membership contains only RFCs transitioned active->archived by this operation
membership is immutable and never expands after commit

tables.name: rfc_archive_events
columns: rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('archived','restored'))
origin_archive_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfc_archive_operations(rfc_archive_operation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: append-only event history determines whether a member is still archived by the referenced operation
restore of one archive operation affects only members whose latest archive event is archived from that same operation
later independent restore/rearchive prevents an older operation restore from changing that RFC

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rfc_terminal_pending_epoch ON rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals(trigger_rfc_id,terminal_epoch_id) WHERE proposal_state='pending'
database_guards: BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE on cascade RFC/WFM membership raises RFC_CASCADE_MEMBERSHIP_IMMUTABLE
cascade proposal UPDATE permits only governed pending->executed or pending->superseded transition fields; executed/superseded rows reject further UPDATE
BEFORE DELETE on cascade proposals raises RFC_CASCADE_HISTORY_APPEND_ONLY
BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE on archive operations/members/events raises RFC_ARCHIVE_HISTORY_APPEND_ONLY
projection write guard verifies status_text/status_class/status_authority/terminal_epoch consistency and accepts writes only through the governed RFC source-projection service
archive state mutations on rfcs are accepted only when the corresponding archive event/operation evidence is inserted in the same UnitOfWork
cross_domain_fk_rule: WFM snapshot task_id intentionally has no physical FK in LLD-03 because LLD-05 owns Task schema and may be migrated later; capture and execution both validate immutable Task identity/revision through the same-UoW participant interface, and exact-schema verification treats this as an explicit cross-domain evidence reference rather than relational ownership.
